{"code": "import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Use manual OLS via matrix algebra to avoid dependency issues

# Prepare data: one-hot encode categorical variables
X = pd.get_dummies(data_clean, columns=['site', 'severity', 'sex', 'assay_batch'], drop_first=True)

# Define outcome and predictors
y = X['biomarker_change']
X = X.drop(columns=['biomarker_change', 'patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'arm'])

# Add constant (intercept)
X = pd.concat([pd.Series(1, index=X.index, name='const'), X], axis=1)

# Convert to numpy arrays
X = X.values
y = y.values

# Compute OLS coefficients manually: (X'X)^(-1)X'y
XtX = np.dot(X.T, X)
XtX_inv = np.linalg.inv(XtX)
beta = np.dot(XtX_inv, np.dot(X.T, y))

# Extract treatment effect
# Find the index of 'arm[T.treatment]' in the column names
col_names = X.columns
treatment_col = 'arm[T.treatment]'
if treatment_col in col_names:
    treatment_idx = list(col_names).index(treatment_col)
    treatment_effect = beta[treatment_idx]
    # Compute standard error manually
    y_pred = np.dot(X, beta)
    residuals = y - y_pred
    n, k = X.shape
    mse = np.sum(residuals**2) / (n - k)
    var_beta = mse * np.diag(XtX_inv)
    se_treatment = np.sqrt(var_beta[treatment_idx])
    # 95% CI
    t_crit = 1.96  # z-value for 95% CI
    ci_lower = treatment_effect - t_crit * se_treatment
    ci_upper = treatment_effect + t_crit * se_treatment
else:
    treatment_effect = np.nan
    se_treatment = np.nan
    ci_lower = np.nan
    ci_upper = np.nan

# Print results
print(f"Treatment effect (adjusted): {treatment_effect:.3f}")
print(f"Standard error: {se_treatment:.3f}")
print(f"95% CI: [{ci_lower:.3f}, {ci_upper:.3f}]")"}
